metadata.time_note: Storm Data entry times should be reviewed in local Standard Time (ST), not daylight time. Candidate reports include standard_time_display.
metadata.tornado_track_policy: Tornado tracks must come from DAT. NCEI begin/end coordinates are not used as a tornado track substitute.

candidate_reports.remark: A powerline was reported to fall onto a house along Highway 425 between Star City and Pine Bluff. No injuries were noted within the home or to responders.
ASOS recorded a measured wind gust of 58 mph at Pine Bluff Airport/Grider Field.
A branch was broken out of a tree approximately 1 mile into Jefferson County along Highway 425.
Multiple trees and powerlines reported down across portions of Pine Bluff.
A tree was blown down onto Pinocha Way in Hot Springs Village.
A tree was reported down across Carmona Drive in Hot Springs Village.
A measure wind gust was measured at KLIT (Little Rock/Clinton National Airport) of 45 mph.
A tree branch was broken behind the Costco. Time determined from radar.
ARDOT weather station (ARD15) on the I-430 bridge reported a measured wind gust of 52 mph.
A large tree branch was broken in the town of Judsonia via a social media picture. Time of event estimated from radar.
Wind gust estimated to be 60 mph within the Chenal area.
A large tree split in half in the St. Charles subdivision of West Little Rock leading to some fence damage via picture and info from meteorologist.
A measured wind gust of 51 mph was recorded at Little Rock/Clinton National Airport.
Multiple trees reported down in Hattieville along AR-Highway 213.
A large tree was reported uprooted in the town of Morrilton via social media picture.
Tree blown down onto B Street near AR Hwy 9.
AWOS station KLRF Little Rock AFB/Jacksonville.
Some tree damage noted along AR Hwy 188 north of Mt. Ida. Pea size hail was also observed here around the same time.
Report from mPING: Quarter (1.00 in.).
Report from mPING: Dime (0.75 in.).
Report from mPING: Dime (0.75 in.).
Tree fell onto a home along Jackson Street near the intersection of Markham Street.
ASOS station KLIT Little Rock Adams Field.
Tree blown down.
A large tree was blown down in this area.
A partial wall collapse occurred on the exterior of a retail building at this location.
Flash flooding along Evergreen Drive.
Large amount of water flowing down Hermitage Rd. Water depth estimated to be 1-2 feet. The road became impassable with cars turning around to avoid the area.
Tree limb fell onto a truck.
A tree fell on a house just off Highway 70.
Picture on social media of a tree down on 27th Ave and Poplar Street in Pine Bluff. Time estimated from radar.
Damage on Elm St in Black Rock_ roof blown off with trees down and broken windows. Large hail as well_ but no size indicated. Specific location of damage not available for initial report.
Update to previous report. Damage along Elm St in Black Rock with multiple trees down_ roofs blown off of multiple buildings_ including structural damage to the City Hall.
Multiple areas of downed trees and powerlines. Time of damage estimated by radar.
Updated report. Multiple areas of downed trees and powerlines in Tuckerman_ including the school and surrounding fields along Dowell St. Time of damage estimated by radar.
Several trees blown down.
Heber Springs PD reported trees down on powerlines_ and a structure in town. Several boats on Greers Ferry Lake were blown ashore as well. No injuries were reported.
Social media picture of uprooted trees in Bald Knob from broadcast media. Time estimated from radar.
Trees blown down.
Pictures and video shows water over roadway near Orleans Drive.
Six hour rainfall accumulation ending at 11AM from a PWS.
Rock Creek along Chenal Parkway was flooded. This impacted much of the Rock Creek Trail system which was inaccessible due to the high water.
Six hour rainfall accumulation ending at 1130 AM from a personal weather station.
Boone County OEM reported a car stalled in 2.5 feet of flood water near E. Stephenson and Necessity Rds next to Crooked Creek.
